question_text: Was the Dropbox outage on Nov 20 a cyberattack?
answer_text: Reported, on Dropbox's own account: its status page says the outage was not caused by a cyberattack or by AI acting on its own. No independent source has confirmed that, and Dropbox has not given a cause.
label: Reported
what_would_settle_it: A Dropbox post-incident report giving the cause, or a statement from a regulator, CISA or an outside investigator.
A Dropbox post-incident report or other statement naming the cause.

question_text: Was the Dropbox outage part of the same event as this month's other outages?
answer_text: No link has been shown. Dropbox's updates mention no other outage, and the White House said on Nov 18 that it sees no evidence that the recent incidents are related. That release came before the Dropbox outage and does not name Dropbox.
label: Not established
what_would_settle_it: Dropbox, a regulator or an independent investigator tying the incidents together or ruling it out.

question_text: Which Dropbox services were down, and how long did it last?
answer_text: About 45 minutes, 2:28 to 3:13 PM ET on Nov 20. The status page lists 12 components in major outage, including the website, apps, API, Passwords and DocSend. Dropbox Sign is not listed.
label: Confirmed
